verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a public library of workflow or Zap templates for ops users to start from. MCP tool bundles are shareable lists of MCP tools, not workflow templates, so they are an adjacent feature. The community note about integration landing pages does not describe reusable templates. The axis clearly applies to a workflow-automation product, so the absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As an ops user, I can start from a public library of workflow templates instead of building from scratch
